source_snapshot.title: Dubai RTA announces bus route changes from November 20
source_snapshot.text: Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) will introduce changes to several bus routes across the emirate from November 20, including route extensions, revised connections and the cancellation of some sections.The changes aim to improve connectivity across the public transport network and provide better access to key residential, commercial and industrial areas..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..Passengers are advised to check the revised routes and updated timetables on the S’hail app before travelling.Which Dubai bus routes are changing?The RTA has announced the following changes across several areas of Dubai:Jebel Ali and JAFZARoutes F54 and 99 will see changes affecting the section serving the Life Pharmacy bus stop on the seaside.The section will be cancelled, with Route 99 available as an alternative for passengers travelling along the affected stretch.Al Wasl and Al QuozThe section connecting Al Quoz Bus Station to Equiti Metro Bus Stop via Al Wasl Road will be cancelled.Passengers can use Routes 93 and F29 as alternatives. The revised connection to Equiti Metro Bus Stop will run via Al Manara Street, First Al Khail Street and 4th Street.Al Ghubaiba and Al FaqaRoute 66 will be extended in both directions to serve Sheikh Khalifa Bin Saeed Al Maktoum Mosque, providing an additional connection for passengers in the area.Dubai-Hatta Road and LehbabRoute 68 will have additional stops along Dubai-Hatta Road, allowing passengers to transfer to Route E16.Al Quoz Industrial AreaRoute F16 will be rerouted to use Sheikh Zayed Service Road instead of First Al Khail Street when travelling from Garmin Bus Terminus.Dubai World CentralA bus route serving the area will be extended to Dubai World Central, Freight House, improving access to the logistics and commercial district.CherrywoodsRoutes F55 and J05 will be extended to serve the Cherrywoods community.How to check the revised Dubai bus routesPassengers can use the RTA's S’hail app to check updated bus routes, connections and revised timetables before setting off.The RTA has advised commuters to review the changes in advance to avoid delays and plan their journeys using the alternative connections where necessary.The changes will take effect on November 20..RTA adds three new areas to Dubai Bus-On-Demand network as ridership rises 25%.Dubai adds 4 new bus routes, revamps 13 services from July 17.Dubai RTA adds 4 new bus routes and revamps over 70 others.Dubai’s Bus On-Demand: How to book, areas covered, timings and fares

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: In Dubai, several bus routes will change from November 20.
Some sections of bus routes will be cancelled, routes extended, and connections revised to improve transport communication.
Changes will affect areas including Jebel Ali, Al Quoz, Al Faqa, and others.
Route 66 will be extended to Sheikh Khalifa Bin Saeed Al Maktoum Mosque.
Route 68 will have additional stops on Dubai-Hatta Road.
Passengers are advised to check updated routes and timetables in the S’hail app to plan trips considering the changes.

title: Dubai RTA announces bus route changes from November 20
summary_ru: 🚌 Изменения в автобусных маршрутах Дубая с 20 ноября 📅 В Дубае с 20 ноября изменятся несколько автобусных маршрутов. Будут отменены некоторые участки, продлены маршруты и пересмотрены пересадки для улучшения транспортного сообщения. 📍 Изменения коснутся районов Джебель Али, Аль Куз, Аль Факка и других. Например, маршрут 66 продлят до мечети Шейха Халифы бин Саида Аль Мактума, а маршрут 68 получит дополнительные остановки на дороге Дубай-Хатта. 🚇 Пассажирам рекомендуют заранее проверить обновленные маршруты и расписания в приложении S’hail, чтобы планировать поездки с учетом изменений.
